entities.summary: Prince Sattam Bin Abdulaziz University, formerly known as Prince Salman Bin Abdulaziz University, also known as the University of Al-Kharj, is a public university located in the city of Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia. It is under the supervision of the Ministry of Higher Education Saudi Arabia and managed by the Rector of the University, Dr. Abdulaziz Abdullah Alhamid.
